# Swift Conventions

Conventions for Swift code under `swift/`.

<!-- BEGIN_TABLE: generated by scripts/generate-conventions-index.py, edits inside will be overwritten -->

| Convention | File |
| --- | --- |
| Keep SwiftUI views declarative: pass display values and actions; put networking, persistence, and coordination in feature-owned state. | [declarative-views](../conventions/swift/declarative-views.md) |
| Make Swift UI state actor isolation explicit and use Sendable values across concurrency boundaries instead of unchecked isolation escapes. | [explicit-actor-isolation](../conventions/swift/explicit-actor-isolation.md) |
| Change iOS targets and build settings in the checked-in project specification; regenerate the Xcode project rather than editing generated project files. | [generated-project-inputs](../conventions/swift/generated-project-inputs.md) |

<!-- END_TABLE -->
